# Upper weak-region refinement, 2026-10-07

These are fixed-witness numerical partial supports, not completed continuum certificates. Published dual and primal comparisons are extracted plot curves. Smaller support is tighter. The new normal directions target the upper branch where the previous certified polygon was furthest outside the published dual in normalized boundary distance.

## Objective and conventions

For each stored direction `(a,b)`, the objective is `a g0 + b g2`. The amplitude convention and all220 physical rows are unchanged from the prior complete constraint catalogue. Exact binary64 rationals below define each frozen numerical witness; an optimizer stopping status does not establish optimality.

## Search restrictions and physical rows

The 220 physical equality rows are: 39 H2–H40 rows;7 actual X4–X8 crossing rows;60 Roy rows with B=119/10, J=0,2,4,6, n=0..14;64 tapered-strip rows for [12,24] and [24,48], T=4/3, j=0..3, n=0..7;36 transfer derivatives D_t^p with p=1,2,3 applied to H_j (j=2..12) and G_regular;14 resummed cosine/sine rows with r=4/5 and c=-.9,-.75,-.5,0,.5,.75,.9. Full formulas are in `ALL_CONSTRAINTS_HUMAN_READABLE_2026-10-07.md` and the hash-preserved source modules.

Every search additionally enforces numerical threshold, tail and source sign restrictions on multipliers. They restrict the search, and do not by themselves prove physical continuum validity:

- n192, source/angular order96 training cache for even spins0..40.
- Existing large-p training-grid guards with `eps=1e-8`.
- Existing source grid (first861 source restrictions), strengthened by source margin1e-4.
- Every existing broad finite-spin/tau tail guard, margin .01 where a tail margin applies.
- Dense cached V/p guards for every even spin10..40 and mu6.005..20.005, margin .002.
- Additional spin2,4 threshold samples mu=4+1e-8,4+1e-6,4+1e-4, margin .001.
- Exact-polynomial crossing optimizer matrix at cutoff10, degree8; then the saved exact crossing identity/sign replay is checked.
- Roy source Bernstein guard bank16x4, margin1e-4; then the exact fixed-witness Bernstein check is performed.

The all-row dense guards were supplied through `--cached-guards`; source/threshold/crossing/Roy guards remain active. All processes use one OpenBLAS, OMP and MKL thread. Frozen source kernels were not edited.

## Fresh audits and limitations

Each selected witness is evaluated on n192/order96 and independent n384/order128 head caches; the high-spin threshold and large-p screens must pass. Fresh source and UV integrals include even spins42..100. The joint-limit scan uses0 plus8001 linear points through40 and1000 geometric points40..256. Exact Roy source, exact crossing-series and Arb threshold-limit component checks are stored. The dense spin10..40 V/p bank is re-evaluated on each frozen witness.

The numerical partial sum still omits all spins>100, the threshold interval4<mu<4.02 for spins42..100, and rigorous source/spectral quadrature errors. A finite grid or exact sign component does not certify the entire bound.

## Reproduction

Use the interpreter/runtime stated in the main reproduction guide. Run `research/weak_regions_20261007/upper/run_search_campaign.py` for the initial two warm-start trials; the direct g2 warm start for86 was stopped and preserved because a positive-combination warm start was substantially better. Exact commands and arguments for each completed candidate are in its `.json` and complete console trace is in `.log`. The stronger86 chain is `angle86_blended_seed.npz -> angle86_blended.npz -> angle86_refined.npz`. The 83 chain is saved85 -> angle83p1759644845 -> angle83_refined -> angle83_repaired. The intermediate angle83_refined was rejected because its exact crossing-component sign check failed, despite passing all numerical screens. The accepted repair uses99.9% refined +0.1% stage1 coefficients and passes fresh full component audits; smaller attempted repair weights failed and remain saved.

For fresh component audits, run:

```powershell
$env:OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS='1'
$env:OMP_NUM_THREADS='1'
$env:MKL_NUM_THREADS='1'
PYTHON research/weak_regions_20261007/upper/audit_upper.py output/weak_regions_20261007/upper/angle83_repaired.npz output/weak_regions_20261007/upper/angle86_refined.npz
```

This recreates head tables, exact coefficient exports and fresh component summaries. All original witness files, checkpoint files, logs, commands, timings, and alternate candidates are retained. Re-running search is not expected to give bitwise-identical optimizer coefficients across numerical library versions; rechecking the saved coefficients is the reproducible mathematical task.
